---

config:
    theme: 'base'
    themeVariables:
        primaryColor: '#1f2020'
        primaryTextColor: '#f0f0f0'
        background: '#333'
        primaryBorderColor: '#888888'
        lineColor: '#999'

---

stateDiagram

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

INIT

INIT : INIT

INIT : enter / { SupervisorMbd_logStateEntry("INIT"); }

NORMAL

NORMAL : NORMAL

NORMAL : enter / { SupervisorMbd_logStateEntry("NORMAL"); }

NORMAL : EV_PRIMARY_HEARTBEAT_OK / { SupervisorMbd_resetPrimaryFaultCounter(); }

PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE

PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE : PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE

PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE : enter / { SupervisorMbd_logStateEntry("PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE"); }

SAFE

SAFE : SAFE

SAFE : enter / { SupervisorMbd_logStateEntry("SAFE"); SupervisorMbd_enterSafeState(); }

SAFE : EV_PRIMARY_HEARTBEAT_OK / { SupervisorMbd_logEvent("IGNORED_PRIMARY_HEARTBEAT_IN_SAFE"); }

FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS

FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS : FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS

FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS : enter / { SupervisorMbd_logStateEntry("FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS"); }

DEGRADED

DEGRADED : DEGRADED

DEGRADED : enter / { SupervisorMbd_logStateEntry("DEGRADED"); }

RECOVERY_DETECTED

RECOVERY_DETECTED : RECOVERY_DETECTED

RECOVERY_DETECTED : enter / { SupervisorMbd_logStateEntry("RECOVERY_DETECTED"); }

RECOVERY_DETECTED : EV_PRIMARY_HEARTBEAT_OK / { SupervisorMbd_logEvent("PRIMARY_STILL_RECOVERED"); }

ROOT.(InitialState) --> INIT

INIT --> NORMAL : EV_INIT_DONE / { SupervisorMbd_setActiveOwnerPrimary(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("INIT", "NORMAL"); }

NORMAL --> PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE : EV_PRIMARY_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT / { SupervisorMbd_incrementPrimaryFaultCounter(); SupervisorMbd_logEvent("PRIMARY_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT"); }

NORMAL --> SAFE : EV_CRITICAL_FAULT / { SupervisorMbd_enterSafeState(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("NORMAL", "SAFE"); }

PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE --> NORMAL : EV_PRIMARY_HEARTBEAT_OK / { SupervisorMbd_resetPrimaryFaultCounter(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE", "NORMAL"); }

PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE --> FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS : EV_FAULT_CONFIRMATION_REACHED / { SupervisorMbd_declarePrimaryFault(); SupervisorMbd_isolatePrimary(); SupervisorMbd_requestBackupActivation(); SupervisorMbd_startBackupActivationTimer(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("PRIMARY_FAULT_CANDIDATE", "FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS"); }

FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS --> DEGRADED : EV_BACKUP_ACTIVE_ACK / { SupervisorMbd_stopBackupActivationTimer(); SupervisorMbd_setActiveOwnerBackup(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS", "DEGRADED"); }

FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS --> SAFE : EV_BACKUP_ACTIVATION_TIMEOUT / { SupervisorMbd_enterSafeState(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("FAILOVER_IN_PROGRESS", "SAFE"); }

DEGRADED --> RECOVERY_DETECTED : EV_PRIMARY_RECOVERY_DETECTED / { SupervisorMbd_logEvent("PRIMARY_RECOVERY_DETECTED"); }

DEGRADED --> SAFE : EV_CRITICAL_FAULT / { SupervisorMbd_enterSafeState(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("DEGRADED", "SAFE"); }

RECOVERY_DETECTED --> NORMAL : EV_MANUAL_FAILBACK_APPROVED / { SupervisorMbd_requestBackupStandby(); SupervisorMbd_setActiveOwnerPrimary(); SupervisorMbd_resetPrimaryFaultCounter(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("RECOVERY_DETECTED", "NORMAL"); }

RECOVERY_DETECTED --> SAFE : EV_CRITICAL_FAULT / { SupervisorMbd_enterSafeState(); SupervisorMbd_logTransition("RECOVERY_DETECTED", "SAFE"); }
